primary_sources: Pazos M, Traverso CE, Viswanathan A; European Glaucoma Society. Terminology and guidelines for glaucoma, 6th edition. Br J Ophthalmol 2025;109(Suppl 1):1-212
Gedde SJ, Vinod K, Wright MM, et al. Primary open-angle glaucoma preferred practice pattern. Ophthalmology 2021;128(1S):P71-P150
Chauhan BC, Garway-Heath DF, Goñi FJ, et al. Practical recommendations for measuring rates of visual field change in glaucoma. Br J Ophthalmol 2008;92(4):569-573
Heijl A, Leske MC, Bengtsson B, et al. Reduction of intraocular pressure and glaucoma progression: results from the Early Manifest Glaucoma Trial. Arch Ophthalmol 2002;120(10):1268-1279

rules.name: MD slope OLS estimation
rules.source: Chauhan et al. 2008 — practical recommendations for VF rate of change
rules.specification: Estimates the slope of mean deviation (MD) over time using ordinary least squares linear regression
rules.implementation_note: Uses global MD only. Focal progression and pointwise analysis are not captured.

rules.name: Progression rate classification
rules.specification: Classifies the MD slope into four progression categories

thresholds.unclassifiable: Insufficient data, low reliability series, or insufficient time span

rules.implementation_note: Threshold classification follows EGS 2025 recommendations. Five-state output preserved for M5 consumption.

rules.name: Reliability-adjusted analysis
rules.specification: Adjusts confidence in slope estimation based on overall reliability of the series

thresholds.good: All visits with high reliability indices (FN <15%, FP <15%, FL <15%)
thresholds.low: Multiple low-reliability visits or systematic learning effect concern

rules.implementation_note: Low reliability does not block classification but reduces confidence and may push borderline cases to 'unclassifiable'.

rules.name: Series length minimum
rules.source: EGS 2025 + Chauhan 2008 (minimum series for reliable rate)
rules.specification: Sets data sufficiency requirements before slope classification
rules.implementation_note: Below these thresholds, slope is not classified and the result is 'unclassifiable' with explicit cause flag.

rules.name: Statistical significance assessment
rules.specification: Computes 95% CI of the slope and flags whether the slope is statistically distinguishable from zero
logic: If 95% CI excludes zero AND slope worse than -0.5 dB/year: 'significant'
If insufficient observations for CI computation: 'not_assessable'
rules.implementation_note: Statistical significance modulates confidence but does not override the rate-based classification.

rules.name: Caution flags for context
rules.specification: Sets caution flags for clinically relevant contexts that affect interpretation
rules.implementation_note: Caution flags are non-blocking but propagate to M5 for confidence adjustment.

rules.name: Confidence level derivation
rules.specification: Assigns M3 confidence based on data sufficiency, reliability, and statistical significance
logic: If reliability='good' AND sufficient_data AND significant: confidence = 'high'
If reliability='borderline' OR caution_flags present: confidence = 'moderate'
If reliability='low' OR insufficient_data OR not_assessable: confidence = 'low'
rules.implementation_note: M3 confidence is propagated to M5 as one of the inputs determining the integrated confidence level.
